title: Supplier Performance: Promised vs Actual Delivery Days
description:
For each supplier, calculate the average promised delivery days, average actual delivery days, and the average delay (`avg_actual - avg_promised`). A negative delay means the supplier is faster than promised.

**Table: suppliers** — `supplier_id`, `supplier_name`

**Table: deliveries** — `delivery_id`, `supplier_id`, `promised_days`, `actual_days`

Output columns: `supplier_id`, `supplier_name`, `avg_promised_days`, `avg_actual_days`, `avg_delay_days`. Order by `avg_delay_days`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE suppliers (supplier_id INTEGER, supplier_name VARCHAR); CREATE TABLE deliveries (delivery_id INTEGER, supplier_id INTEGER, promised_days INTEGER, actual_days INTEGER); INSERT INTO suppliers VALUES (1,'FastShip Co'),(2,'ReliableGoods'),(3,'Budget Supply'),(4,'Premium Parts'); INSERT INTO deliveries VALUES (1,1,5,4),(2,1,5,3),(3,1,7,8),(4,2,10,10),(5,2,10,9),(6,2,7,7),(7,3,14,18),(8,3,14,20),(9,3,7,10),(10,4,3,3),(11,4,5,4),(12,4,7,6);
solution_sql: SELECT s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name, ROUND(AVG(d.promised_days::NUMERIC), 2) AS avg_promised_days, ROUND(AVG(d.actual_days::NUMERIC), 2) AS avg_actual_days, ROUND(AVG(d.actual_days::NUMERIC) - AVG(d.promised_days::NUMERIC), 2) AS avg_delay_days FROM suppliers s JOIN deliveries d ON s.supplier_id = d.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ORDER BY avg_delay_days;

test_cases.description: 4 suppliers; Budget Supply has highest delay (+5.33); FastShip and Premium Parts deliver ahead of schedule

hints: JOIN suppliers to deliveries and GROUP BY supplier to aggregate averages.
avg_delay_days = AVG(actual_days) - AVG(promised_days). A negative value means deliveries are arriving early on average.
Cast to NUMERIC before AVG for precise decimal results.
explanation: FastShip Co: promised avg 5.67, actual avg 5.0, delay = -0.67 (slightly early). ReliableGoods: promised 9.0, actual 8.67, delay = -0.33 (slightly early). Budget Supply: promised 11.67, actual 16.0, delay = +4.33 (very late). Premium Parts: promised 5.0, actual 4.33, delay = -0.67 (early). Budget Supply is the worst performer.
